Title: Epic A — Observability baseline
Body: Baseline observability for all LLM, RAG, and agent requests: OpenTelemetry traces, operational dashboards, and immutable audit logs. Foundation for every other dimension.

Title: Epic B — Golden dataset and regression testing
Body: Golden datasets, production-failure promotion, and CI regression gating so unreliable changes never reach production.

Title: Epic C — Functional reliability evaluation
Body: Configurable LLM-as-judge evaluators, statistical confidence reporting, and CI evaluation gates for functional reliability.

Title: Epic D — Security guardrails and red teaming
Body: Input/output guardrails, tool-call authorization, automated adversarial testing, and OWASP-mapped evidence for security reliability.

Title: Epic E — Operational reliability controls
Body: Circuit breakers, fallback behavior, budget/rate-limit controls, and anomaly alerts to keep AI systems predictable and efficient.

Title: Epic F — Temporal reliability and drift
Body: Drift detection, canary deployment with auto-rollback, audit trail, and incident recurrence tracking to keep reliability stable over time.

Title: Epic G — Standards, compliance, and reporting
Body: Control-to-standard mapping, audit-ready reporting, reliability score dashboard, and threat-landscape documentation.
Standard: CSA AICM; EU AI Act; ENISA FAICP

Title: A1. Instrument AI requests with OpenTelemetry
Body:
As an AI engineer, I want every LLM, RAG, and agent request traced with OpenTelemetry, so that I can debug failures and measure latency and cost.

The traced subject is an AI agent that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API to its callers and calls an upstream LLM provider. Both hops are traced. Instrumentation is deliberately minimal: enough to feed A2's dashboard, no more.

AC:
- `forge_otel` (Python 3.12, OpenTelemetry SDK + OTLP exporter only, no vendor SDK): `init_tracing(app)` for FastAPI and `llm_call()` around the outbound provider call.
- Inbound server span per `/v1/chat/completions` request: request.id, tenant.id, gen_ai.request.model, http.response.status_code.
- Outbound client span: gen_ai.provider.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens.
- llm.cost.usd from a static model->price map, env-overridable; unknown model omits the attribute.
- prompt.text and completion.text captured on the span; FORGE_OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT=0 records prompt.sha256 and completion.sha256 instead.
- Errors set span status ERROR and record the exception. No sampling configuration.
- Exports OTLP/HTTP to FORGE_OTEL_ENDPOINT; unset = no-op.
- Mock upstream committed: FastAPI serving OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, non-streaming, deterministic, no API key, no network.
- Tests: pytest + InMemorySpanExporter covering the attribute set, the content toggle, and the error path.

Non-goals: streaming, sampling, latency-split accounting, retrieval and tool spans, dashboards (A2), audit log (A3), real guardrails (D1/D2), circuit breakers (E1), drift detection (F1), auth and tenancy enforcement.

Title: A2. Create operational reliability dashboard
Body:
As an SRE, I want a dashboard for P95 latency, error rate, token usage, and cost per tenant, so that I can detect operational degradation.
AC:
- P95/P99 latency, error rate, token usage, cost per request, circuit-breaker trips
- Alerts at thresholds defined in MATRIX.md §3.3
- Linked trace samples from any alert

Title: A3. Record audit log for guardrail decisions
Body:
As a compliance officer, I want guardrail decisions logged with input hash, policy, action, and timestamp, so that I can produce audit evidence.
AC:
- Append-only / immutable log
- Fields: input hash, policy version, action, reason, timestamp
- CSV/JSON export

Title: B1. Create and import golden datasets
Body:
As an evaluation engineer, I want to create or import golden datasets with inputs, expected outputs, rubrics, and tags, so that I can evaluate functional reliability consistently.
AC:
- CSV/JSON import with input, expected output, rubric, dimension tag, source
- Dataset versioning
- Editable in UI and API

Title: B2. Turn production failures into golden-dataset candidates
Body:
As a product owner, I want production failures flagged by evaluators to become candidate golden-dataset cases, so that incidents become regression tests.
AC:
- Promote failed trace to candidate case
- Reviewer approves/rejects
- Approved cases join next regression suite

Title: B3. Run regression suite on model/prompt changes
Body:
As a release manager, I want the golden-dataset regression suite to run automatically on PRs and model/prompt changes, so that unreliable changes are blocked before deployment.
AC:
- CI job runs on PR
- Fails if pass rate drops below threshold
- Summary posted to PR
- Manual override requires approval record

Title: C1. Configure LLM-as-judge evaluators
Body:
As an evaluation engineer, I want configurable LLM-as-judge evaluators for hallucination, faithfulness, relevance, and context recall, so that I can measure functional reliability.
AC:
- Rubrics configurable per use case
- Scores stored per trace
- Evaluator version recorded
- Reference-based and reference-free modes

Title: C2. Report statistical confidence for evaluations
Body:
As a data scientist, I want evaluation reports to include confidence intervals and benchmark vs. generalized accuracy, so that release decisions are not based on point estimates.
AC:
- Sample size and confidence interval in every report
- Benchmark vs. generalized distinction (NIST AI 800-3)
- Exportable as JSON/PDF

Title: C3. Add functional evaluation gate to CI
Body:
As a release manager, I want a CI gate that blocks deployment when functional reliability metrics regress, so that hallucinations and faithfulness failures do not reach users.
AC:
- Checks hallucination rate, faithfulness, relevance against configured thresholds
- Produces pass/fail artifact
- Blocks merge when failing

Title: D1. Deploy input guardrails for prompt injection and system-prompt leakage
Body:
As a security engineer, I want input guardrails that detect prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and system-prompt leakage, so that adversarial inputs are blocked or flagged.
AC:
- Regex + ML detectors
- Configurable block/flag/log actions
- Maps detections to OWASP LLM01 and LLM07
- False-positive review queue

Title: D2. Deploy output guardrails for PII and unsafe content
Body:
As a security engineer, I want output guardrails that redact PII and flag unsafe content, so that sensitive information is not disclosed.
AC:
- PII detection/redaction for configured entity types
- Safety scoring
- Maps to OWASP LLM02 and LLM05
- Audit log entry per action

Title: D3. Run automated adversarial tests in CI
Body:
As a red teamer, I want automated adversarial tests for prompt injection, jailbreak, PII extraction, prompt leakage, and tool-call injection to run in CI, so that security regressions are caught before release.
AC:
- At least 5 attack categories covered
- Runs on PR or scheduled
- Severity-ranked findings
- Findings linked to OWASP LLM Top 10

Title: D4. Enforce tool-call authorization for agents
Body:
As a platform admin, I want agent tool calls checked against permissions before execution, so that excessive agency cannot cause unauthorized actions.
AC:
- Tool allowlist/denylist per agent
- Permission check before execution
- Denied calls logged
- Maps to OWASP LLM06

Title: D5. Map security evidence to OWASP LLM Top 10
Body:
As a compliance officer, I want guardrail and red-team evidence mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10 categories, so that security posture is auditable.
AC:
- Every finding/control has an OWASP category
- Exportable compliance report
- Missing categories highlighted

Title: E1. Add circuit breakers and fallback behavior
Body:
As an SRE, I want circuit breakers and defined fallback behavior when model endpoints degrade, so that failures do not cascade.
AC:
- Circuit breaker opens after configurable error threshold
- Fallback model or safe response configured
- Recovery behavior tested

Title: E2. Add budget and rate-limit controls
Body:
As a FinOps owner, I want per-tenant and per-workload token/cost limits with alerts, so that unbounded consumption does not cause surprise overages.
AC:
- Soft/hard limits
- Alerts at 80% and 100%
- Requests blocked or throttled at hard limit
- Dashboard shows spend by tenant

Title: E3. Detect latency and error anomalies
Body:
As an SRE, I want anomaly alerts on latency and error-rate changes, so that I can respond before users are impacted.
AC:
- Baseline learned per endpoint
- Alerts on P95 latency and error-rate deviation
- Links to trace samples

Title: F1. Detect input and embedding drift
Body:
As an ML engineer, I want drift detection on inputs and embeddings against a reference distribution, so that I can catch data drift before accuracy drops.
AC:
- PSI/KS or embedding-distance method
- Configurable reference window
- Alert on threshold breach
- Drill-down to affected traces

Title: F2. Canary deploy and auto-rollback
Body:
As a release manager, I want canary deployment with automatic rollback when reliability metrics degrade, so that bad model updates have limited blast radius.
AC:
- Canary percentage configurable
- Rollback triggered on functional/security/operational threshold breach
- Audit log of rollback

Title: F3. Maintain model and evaluation audit trail
Body:
As an auditor, I want a versioned audit trail of model changes, evaluation results, and incidents, so that I can reconstruct reliability history.
AC:
- Immutable records
- Filter by model version, date, dimension
- Exportable report

Title: F4. Track incident recurrence rate
Body:
As a reliability lead, I want a dashboard showing incident recurrence by failure mode, so that I can verify closed-loop fixes are working.
AC:
- Incidents tagged by failure mode
- Monthly recurrence rate
- Linked regression test for each fixed incident

Title: G1. Map controls to NIST, ISO, OWASP, and EU AI Act
Body:
As a compliance officer, I want AgentGuard controls mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP LLM Top 10, and EU AI Act requirements, so that I can reuse evidence across frameworks.
AC:
- Control-to-standard mapping table
- Filter by standard
- Exportable evidence package
Standard: CSA AICM; EU AI Act; NIST AI RMF; ISO/IEC 42001; OWASP LLM Top 10

Title: G2. Generate audit-ready compliance report
Body:
As an auditor, I want a report showing control status, evidence links, and gaps by standard, so that I can assess readiness efficiently.
AC:
- Report includes standard, control, status, evidence artifact, owner, date
- PDF/CSV export

Title: G3. Publish reliability score dashboard
Body:
As an executive, I want a single reliability score with drill-down by dimension, so that I can understand risk posture at a glance.
AC:
- Score 0–100 weighted by dimension
- Drill-down to component metrics
- Trend over time

Title: G4. Add threat-landscape note with ARTEX case study
Body:
As a security lead, I want a documented threat-landscape note showing how AI-automated pentesting tools like ARTEX are used by adversaries, so that the team understands why defensive AI guardrails matter.
AC:
- Note cites public reporting
- Links to Security Reliability section
- Reviewed quarterly
